```plato

    // Every spring joining a vertex to the one `step` columns to its right:
    // step 1 is structural, step 2 is bend.
    GridRowSprings(self: ClothGrid3D, step: Integer, compliance: Number): Array<ClothDistanceConstraint>
    {
        var span = (self.ColumnCount - step).Max(0);
        return (span * self.RowCount).MapRange(n =>
            self.GridSpring(n % span, n / span, n % span + step, n / span, compliance));
    }
```
